name: PubMed offline-knowledge agent gate v1
description: End-to-end GLM tool-use gate for ordinary literature questions against the registered PubMed 2026 baseline. It checks retrieval, stable PMIDs, abstract-supported concepts, and exact PubMed citations; it does not score clinical advice.

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, what did the 2012 paper about a programmable dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease report about how Cas9 cuts DNA and its potential use?

alternatives: dual RNA directs Cas9 to introduce double stranded breaks
two RNA structure directs Cas9 to introduce double stranded breaks

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, summarize what the obese and lean twin study found about a core gut microbiome.

alternatives: core microbiome at the gene level
functional core rather than organismal lineage
altered representation of bacterial genes and metabolic pathways

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, what limitations and promising technologies did the review on amyloid beta and tau blood biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease identify?

alternatives: lower than levels in cerebrospinal fluid
